title: Oscar and the Confession
author: Silas Okafor
blurb: Astrid Eastwick, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
